resourceProfile.assessment: Canonical English, complete effective Bengali runtime content, repository checks, and targeted Bengali technical terminology searches were available.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review generation and TypeScript checking passed after every correction batch.

linguisticCritique.summary: Three complete-scope passes resolved 75 terminology, discharge-label, technical-concept, and Bengali grammar findings.

competentHumanReview.summary: The Bengali corrections were machine-reviewed and still require competent human review.

publicationAuthorization.summary: This cycle authorizes a locale-specific commit only, not publication or deployment.

findings.summary: Twenty-five shared UI, calculator, comparison, and concept entries retained inconsistent power and resistance terminology.
evidence: Electrical power and resistance used mixed transliterations and Bengali engineering terms.
Several loading labels used three periods instead of the locale ellipsis.
Core concept statements retained machine-literal technical phrasing.
findings.resolution: Standardized Bengali power and resistance terminology and corrected shared labels and foundational concept prose.

findings.summary: Twenty-five battery-discharge, Ohm, Joule, Kirchhoff, TCR, heat-flux, and SI entries remained awkward or ambiguous.
evidence: Continuous-discharge templates contained a duplicated article and mixed discharge terms.
Technical concepts mixed resistance with resistivity and power with energy terminology.
Several headings retained untranslated English possessives or literal machine constructions.
findings.resolution: Rewrote discharge templates and standardized circuit, thermal, and SI terminology without changing protected values.

findings.summary: Twenty-five visible messages and concept summaries used incomplete Bengali sentences, English punctuation, or unnatural calques.
evidence: Several no-result and saved-state messages were grammatically incomplete.
Converter precision help omitted necessary case marking.
Concept summaries and descriptions read as literal word-order transfers.
findings.resolution: Replaced the affected strings with complete, natural Bengali sentences and clearer technical summaries.
